objective_hierarchy.principle: Prefer the model that picks more NFL winners. Use probability-quality metrics as tie-breakers and safety diagnostics, not as a reason to reject a genuinely more accurate winner classifier unless probability quality becomes materially pathological.

historical_context.interpretation: F-ST was descriptively five wins better on this historical sample, but the difference is too small to treat as statistically resolved without paired disagreement data.

paired_accuracy_estimand.primary_comparison: candidate correctness minus incumbent correctness on the same games
paired_accuracy_estimand.disagreement_set: games where candidate and incumbent select different winners
paired_accuracy_estimand.switch_win_rate: candidate-correct-and-incumbent-wrong divided by all disagreement games
paired_accuracy_estimand.key_identity: overall accuracy can change only on disagreement games
inferential_methods: week-block bootstrap of paired zero-one-loss difference
McNemar-style discordant-pair accounting as a non-clustered diagnostic

horizon_family.point_in_time_contract: strict no-later-than cutoff; valid timing error [-7.5, 0] minutes
horizon_family.primary_sample: same games with valid strict-PIT forecasts at all four horizons
horizon_family.family_inference: family-level comparison on zero-one loss with week clustering and multiplicity control
horizon_family.if_accuracy_unresolved: retain the incumbent or earliest statistically indistinguishable operationally adequate horizon; do not promote solely for better Brier

promotion_logic.accuracy_superiority_required: candidate paired winner-accuracy advantage must be positive and supported by week-aware uncertainty before claiming superior accuracy
promotion_logic.if_accuracy_is_statistically_unresolved: do not replace a higher-accuracy incumbent merely because Brier is better

secondary_probability_guardrail.role: secondary safety guardrail, not primary optimization target

training_policy.reason: historical LevLine adaptive accuracy-weight searches were unstable across seasons and underperformed both the market and the frozen F-ST winner rate
training_policy.preferred_training: classification-calibrated regularized surrogate objectives trained chronologically, then evaluated primarily on out-of-sample zero-one loss
training_policy.probability_calibration: secondary and preferably pick-preserving; calibration must not silently change winner labels unless entered as a separate accuracy candidate
